newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia firm sees DeBeers deal signed in Jan - agency.
newsitem.headline: Russia firm sees DeBeers deal signed in Jan - agency.

text.p: Russia will sign a diamond export deal with De Beers in January 1997, Itar-Tass news agency quoted a top official at De Beers' negotiating partner Almazy Rossii-Sakha (ARS) as saying on Monday.
It quoted Lev Safonov, first vice-president of the diamond producer, as saying Finance Minister Alexander Livshits had ordered approval of a draft agreement be speeded up.
It did not directly quote Safonov.
Livshits said on Friday that a deal with De Beers was essential and could be signed next year.
De Beers has given Russia until the end of 1996 to approve a draft agreement on diamond exports or face termination of an interim accord.
